liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Comes A Time** (2 reviews): Reviewer hears pain in Jerry's vocal; first solo screams, second ends on a menacing two-note phrase; Reviewer says Jerry mangled vocals, played a bad solo, and ended with an off-key two-note solo; played 65 times [9][18]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Show opens with a strong version [10]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): Band finds a great space again; Jerry's vocal and guitar convey the mood well [10]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): Singled out as great, along with He's Gone and the Space into Comes A Time [16]
- **He's Gone** (1 other source): A 40-second patch from Noah Weiner's AKG D202E source fills in this song [2]

## The recordings

- **gd78-05-16.akg.weiner.8333.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 176 min; rated 3.74/5 by 23 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience recording sounds very good and impressive to this reviewer; Nice audience recording; Donna is not too far off; Recording is splendid with minimal audience noise, but Phil is low in the mix; equalizing helps [7][13][16]
- **gd1978-05-16.164765.aud.composite.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 177 min [2]
- **gd1978-05-16.164764.aud.composite.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 21 songs; 177 min [3]
- **gd1978-05-16.jvc.jaret.minches.106548.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 158 min [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer, aged 17, grew up on Dead shows at the Uptown in Chicago [13]
- Reviewer considers the May 10 show better than this one [10]
- Lists other 1978 Uptown runs: January 30, 31, February 1, May 17, November 16, 17, 18 [13]
- Band has great energy this night and the next night [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd78-05-16.akg.weiner.8333.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: AKG D202E mics > Sony TC-152 [1]. Also: Dire Wolf from a soundboard source circulates on RadioioDead.com, reportedly a gift from David Lemieux; Taped with AKG D202E mics into Sony TC-152, then DAT and CD WAV, via Noah Weiner [1][12]
- **gd1978-05-16.164765.aud.composite.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Tim McKenzie; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: 2 different sources combine to provide the complete show. Neither source appears to be in general circulation. The primary source containing the first set and… [2]. Also: Composite from second-generation cassettes from Tim McKenzie, transferred by Charlie Miller, with patches from Nakamichi 300 and AKG sources [2]
- **gd1978-05-16.164764.aud.composite.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Tim McKenzie; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: 2 different sources combine to provide the complete show. Neither source appears to be in general circulation. The primary source containing the first set and… [3]
- **gd1978-05-16.jvc.jaret.minches.106548.flac16**: taped by Phil Jaret; transferred by David Minches; source: JVC M-201 Stereo Microphone> Teac PC-10 [4]
